title: rfc
description: The specification rfc-writer composes in Decide and hands to scripts/render_rfc.py (SDS-S-080, a skill-local shape). Sections follow the order a reviewer needs them in and are exactly the ones design-doc-review's checklist requires, so a rendered RFC passes that skill's structural pass by construction: motivation before proposal, goals with non-goals, at least two alternatives each with why it lost, risks each with a mitigation or an explicit acceptance, a rollout with its rollback, and open questions each with an owner.

summary.description: The whole RFC in three sentences: the change, why, and the cost.

motivation.description: The situation that makes the change worth its cost, stated so a reader who rejects the proposal still agrees with this.

nonGoals.description: What this deliberately does not attempt; a goals list with no non-goals is a wish list.

mitigation.description: A mitigation, or the word 'accepted' with the reason.

owner.description: Who will answer it; empty is refused by the render script.
